name: Sammiana Z2
description_md:
Sammiana Z2 is a national waymarked hiking route in MK covering a distance of 195.8 km. This hard route involves 9547 m of ascent and 9584 m of descent.

The itinerary requires about 75 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty rating is derived from the distance and the total ascent.
